main_body: brick kitchen range with a sloped metal hood, cooktop surface, and lower brick firebox
top_band: rows 21-25 dark grey sloped hood top and rows 28-34 grey cooktop surface framed in light grey
evidence: Reading down the center column: above the range is a brick chimney (rows 8-20); the range hood has a light top edge at row 21, a 4-row sloped surface (rows 22-25), a dark front edge (row 26), and an eave shadow (row 27). Below that is a 7-row foreshortened cooktop surface (rows 28-34) with a light front edge at row 34, a shadow lip at row 35, and a 12-row brick front face (rows 36-47) containing an inset firebox (rows 37-44).

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul stall and roofed well references, the candidate is geometric and flat: the metal hood (rows 22-25) is an unshaded 26x4 single-colour fill outlined in near-black, the cooktop frame is an unvaried single-colour 1px rectangle with mechanical checkerboard dithering inside, the chimney bricks are identical flat rectangles, and the firebox grates and flames are rigid vertical stripes.
